knownDefects.preventionEvidence: The style reference is hash-bound and used only for adult editorial pop-art grammar; the prompt neither requests nor permits a copied identity, person or composition.
The neutral workbench is only physical support for an explanatory metaphor. The prompt excludes named places, government settings, brands and invented official scenes.
The module, lens stand, inspection card and bench support are required objects with coherent planes for pixel inspection.
The prompt forbids people, hands, bodies, MAiVENs and TRAiLBLAZERs, so no anatomy or likeness claim can enter.
The text plan is NO_VISIBLE_TEXT and the prompt forbids readable labels, generated text, fake UI, logos and watermarks.
Only contemporary generic computing and inspection objects are permitted; no costume, retro prop or era-specific novelty is allowed.

The companion calls embedded evaluators Anthropic’s proposal and stated commitment, not a federal requirement. The art represents only a question of checking and forbids a law, government inspection, result or actual evaluator access.
Each dominant object has one explanatory job: module for capability and lens/card for independent inspection. Decorative people, official artifacts and unrelated clutter are prohibited.
